easy.def: A time when people vote to choose a leader.
examples: We held an election.
The election is in November.
Our class had an election for president.

more.def: A time when people vote to choose a leader or decide something.
examples: The class held an election for president.
The election is held every four years.
Many people waited in line to vote on election day.
I have an electric toothbrush.
The car is electric.
An electric light is on.
I use an electric toothbrush.
The electric train ran along the track.
Dad bought an electric car.
Water is one element of a lake.
The story has an element of surprise.
Each element is important.

more.def: A basic part of something larger, or a simple substance such as gold or oxygen.
examples: Gold is an element found in the ground.
Oxygen is an element in the air we breathe.
Fire needs three elements: fuel, heat and air.

easy.def: A very big gray animal with a long trunk.
examples: An elephant is big.
The elephant has a trunk.
We saw an elephant.

more.def: The largest animal that lives on land, with a long trunk and big ears.
examples: The elephant sprayed water with its trunk.
An elephant can weigh thousands of pounds.
The baby elephant followed its mother.

easy.def: A small room that moves people up and down in a building.
examples: We took the elevator to the top floor.
The elevator is full.
Push the button for the elevator.

more.def: A small moving room that carries people from one floor of a building to another.
examples: The elevator stopped at the fifth floor.
An elevator carried the luggage to the hotel rooms.
Please use the elevator if you have heavy bags.
I am eleven.
There are eleven players on a soccer team.
Eleven kids came.

more.def: The number that comes after ten, written 11.
examples: A soccer team puts eleven players on the field.
My brother is eleven years old.
The clock struck eleven.
What else can we do?
Ask someone else.
I want something else.

more.def: In addition, or different from what has been named.
examples: Is there anything else you need for your project?
If the park is closed, where else can we play?
Ask someone else if you cannot find me.
